Faces may use 1-2 dark square pixels for expression, and orc tusks 1-2 pale squares. Do not pack in more detail.
ABSOLUTE AVOIDS: smooth cartoon figures, fine ink, long pointed triangular spikes, polished shading, round glossy eyes or orbs, huge heads/weapons, flattened legless bodies, decorative trim, tiny line details, painterly/3D forms, glow or particles, blur, labels or UI.
